Modifiers

The game’s installed passives and usable rack items, with their authored descriptions. Provisional entries are still being tried out; retired entries remain here for historical saves. This is a reference, not a shop inventory or a guarantee of availability.

42 entries · Read the game rules

×2

Certified

Doubles every scored line. Unlimited use.

×4

Certified

Quadruples every scored line. Unlimited use.

Ace Exchange

Certified

Discard at least two Aces together to gain one random passive you do not own. Triggers once per qualifying discard; unlimited use.

Carnivore

Certified

Doubles the base value of each meat block in a scored line. Unlimited use.

Could It Be Magic Now?

Provisional

Counts your plays. Every fourth play, after reactions, turns one random non-Magic card on the field to Magic. Provisional trial.

Crossroads

Certified

Adds 3 points for each block in a scored line that crosses another line. Unlimited use.

Custard transmogrifier

Certified

Turns a card in your hand or on the table to Custard, keeping its rank and suit. Uses: 2.

D12

Certified

Rolls 1–12 once each time lines score, and adds the roll to every scored line. Unlimited use.

D20

Certified

Rolls 1–20 once each time lines score, and adds the roll to every scored line. Unlimited use.

D6

Certified

Rolls 1–6 once each time lines score, and adds the roll to every scored line. Unlimited use.

D8

Certified

Rolls 1–8 once each time lines score, and adds the roll to every scored line. Unlimited use.

Dense

Provisional

Raises each scored row to a power of up to 1.3 the more tightly the playfield is packed: no bonus at 70% or less, 1.3 when its bounding box is full.

Dense (trial)

Provisional

Multiplies each scored row by up to ×10 as the field's packing density rises past 70%. Provisional trial.

Diversity (trial)

Provisional

Multiplies each scored row by ×2 for two material families among its scored blocks, ×4 for three or more. Provisional trial.

Do Nothing

Certified · Retired — historical entry

Has no effect. Unlimited use.

Gold Standard

Certified

When you win a stage, +1 coin for each gold block still in your hand.

Certified

Heavy

Provisional

Multiplies each scored row by up to ×10 the heavier everything in the playfield is: ×1 up to about 19.3 kg (one gold block), ×10 at four gold blocks' mass or more.

Heavy, mean mass (trial)

Provisional

Multiplies each scored row by up to ×10, more for a heavier mean mass of its scored blocks. Provisional trial.

Heavy, total mass (trial)

Provisional

Multiplies each scored row by up to ×10, more for a heavier total mass of its scored blocks. Provisional trial.

Ice transmogrifier

Certified

Turns a card in your hand or on the table to Ice, keeping its rank and suit. Uses: 2.

In the Loop

Provisional

While the field has a hoop or tunnel (blocks joined face to face), raises each scored row to ^1.2. Provisional trial.

Le Chef

Certified

After each stage, each Bloody, Rare or Medium Rare steak on the table pays 3 coins instead of 1.

Light

Provisional

Multiplies each scored row by up to ×10 the lighter everything in the playfield is: ×1 at 1 kg or more, ×10 at 0.1 kg or less.

Light, mean mass (trial)

Provisional

Multiplies each scored row by up to ×10, more for a lighter mean mass of its scored blocks. Provisional trial.

Light, total mass (trial)

Provisional

Multiplies each scored row by up to ×10, more for a lighter total mass of its scored blocks. Provisional trial.

Long Haul

Certified

Subtracts 5 from two-block lines; adds 5 to lines of three or more. Final scores cannot go below zero. Unlimited use.
